title: Implement generation trigger UI with real-time status
description: Implement the generation trigger section on the batch detail page. Allows running generation for all pending prospects with real-time status updates via polling or SSE.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Generate All Pending' button is visible when there are pending/failed prospects
While generation runs, a progress indicator shows (e.g., X of Y complete)
Prospect table updates in real-time (status changes from pending → processing → ready/failed)
Failed prospects show an error message or tooltip with the failure reason
Button is disabled and shows 'Generating...' while in progress
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.description: Add GenerateTrigger client component to batch detail page
steps.details: Create `src/components/admin/GenerateTrigger.tsx`. Shows 'Generate All Pending' button if batch has pending or failed prospects. On click, POST to `/api/generate/batch/[id]`.
After triggering generation, poll GET `/api/batches/[id]/prospects` every 3 seconds. Update the prospect list state with fresh statuses. Stop polling when all are done (no pending/processing).
During generation: show a progress bar or 'X of Y generated' counter. Use shadcn/ui Progress component.
On completion: show a toast 'Generation complete. X succeeded, Y failed.' Failed rows show error_message in a tooltip on the status badge.
Take Playwright screenshot showing the generation trigger section with progress indicator visible.

technicalNotes: Generation runs asynchronously in the API route — the response returns 202 immediately, client polls for updates.
Use setInterval with cleanup (clearInterval in useEffect cleanup) for polling.
